verses.1: Woe to you, O mighty ones of Israel, for the Lord is angry with you because you have not done justice for the orphans.
verses.2: Woe to you who go early in the morning to the house of drinking, and become drunk and indulge yourselves, and do not seek justice for the orphans and the widows, but sit in spectacles and vanity.
verses.3: Thus says the Lord to the mighty ones of Israel: Woe to you, because you have not walked in my commandment, and have not kept my word, and have not loved what I love.
verses.4: And I also will bring upon you punishment and terror and sickness, and you shall be consumed as grass and stubble are devoured, and no remnant of you shall be found in your land.
verses.5: And your land shall become a desolation, and everyone who sees it at first will clap his hands and hiss at it, saying, 'Is this the land that was full of blessing and every good thing?' Thus the Lord has done evil to those who dwell in it.
verses.6: Woe to her who has hardened her heart, and lifted up her head, and stiffened her neck, until the Lord removes her from the face of the earth; and because of the pride of those who dwell in her, she has become a desolation, and thorns and thistles have grown up over her.
verses.7: And she has become a waste and a ruin, and has become a wilderness and a desolation, and wild beasts shall dwell in her.
verses.8: And she has become a horror to all who pass through her, for the wrath of the Lord has fallen upon her, and she has been removed from her place because of the pride of heart in the wickedness of those who dwell in her.
